before.label: EC2 Servers
before.text:
• Manage OS updates
• Pay for idle time
• Scale is manual
• Handle capacity planning

after.label: Lambda
after.text:
• AWS handles OS
• Pay only for execution
• Auto-scaling included
• Write code, not infrastructure

slides.title: How Lambda Works
points: You upload code (Python, Node, Java, etc.)
AWS runs it only when triggered (event-driven)
Scales automatically from 1 to thousands of executions
You pay only for compute time used (in milliseconds)

slides.mermaid:
graph LR

slides.title: Hello World Lambda
Lambda Pricing
points: First 1 million requests per month are free
Pay $0.20 per 1 million requests after that

slides.title: Lambda in Production
items: Cold starts: First execution can be slow (100ms-1s+)
15-minute timeout: Not suitable for long-running jobs
Memory determines CPU: More memory = faster code
Use provisioned concurrency for predictable traffic
